label: Yandex Direct (Яндекс Директ)
terms_note: API access requires an app registered with Yandex OAuth and an approved access request; sandbox testing before production (read on the API page).

discovery.auth: oauth2 (Yandex OAuth app registration + Direct API access application; Authorization: Bearer, Client-Login for agencies)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (API Директа v5) Confidence: **high** — official docs read.
auth: 1. Register the application at oauth.yandex.ru and file the Direct API access application (заявка на доступ); wait for approval.
2. The Direct user grants the app an OAuth token; agencies add `Client-Login: <client>` to act on a client account.
3. Headers `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, `Accept-Language`, `Use-Operator-Units` (spend points from the agency); JSON `{method, params}` body.

endpoints.notes: Name, StartDate, DailyBudget{Amount, Mode}, TextCampaign{BiddingStrategy}, NegativeKeywords, TimeTargeting

endpoints.call: ads` add / update / get / moderate / suspend / resume · `adimages` add · `creatives
endpoints.notes: TextAd{Title, Title2, Text, Href, AdImageHash}, ImageData base64

endpoints.notes: Keyword, AdGroupId, Bid, ContextBid, StrategyPriority; Bids[{KeywordId, Bid}]

reference.limits: - Points (баллы) quota per user per day, 'Ограничения, баллы' page; sandbox with test data; access application review; free API; Direct API terms of use.
mcp_sdk: Official examples + client libraries listed on the landing page (Примеры); no MCP found.

fields.name: token
fields.help: Yandex OAuth token of the Direct user (app registered at oauth.yandex.com with Direct API access approved; https://yandex.com/dev/direct/doc/en/concepts/auth-token), sent as Authorization: Bearer.

config_fields.name: client_login
config_fields.help: Advertiser login to act for, sent as the Client-Login header (required for agency and representative tokens; omit for a direct advertiser).

me.note: POST /json/v5/clients {method: get}: the advertiser the token (or Client-Login) acts for ({result: {Clients: [{ClientId, Login, Currency}]}}).

list_accounts.note: POST /json/v5/clients {method: get}: the advertiser the token acts for (agencies list clients through the AgencyClients service instead). `id` is the Login usable as the client_login config.

list_campaigns.note: POST /json/v5/campaigns {method: get, params: {SelectionCriteria: {States: [status]}, FieldNames, Page: {Limit, Offset}}} for the token's advertiser (account_id is not sent; set client_login for agencies). `status` filters State: ON, OFF, SUSPENDED, ENDED, ARCHIVED. budget_micros is DailyBudget.Amount, the currency amount multiplied by 1,000,000.

pause_resume.note: POST /json/v5/campaigns {method: suspend|resume, params: {SelectionCriteria: {Ids: [campaign_id]}}}. Per-campaign problems come back inside suspend_result/resume_result.Errors (Yandex's operation-array pattern), so check it; request-level errors are reported as failures. Resuming restarts spending.

not_offered.get_report: Yandex Direct statistics come from the Reports service, which returns TSV text (not JSON) and may answer 201/202 while a report is built offline (https://yandex.com/dev/direct/doc/reports/reports); the runtime maps JSON only and has no report polling.
not_offered.update_budget: Campaign daily budgets are micro-units ("DailyBudget.Amount (long)" in the currency multiplied by 1,000,000, POST /json/v5/campaigns method update, https://yandex.com/dev/direct/doc/en/campaigns/update); the adapter cannot scale a daily_budget into micros.

evidence: host api.direct.yandex.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.2 (GlobalSign nv-sa)
probe: 4/4 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 4/4 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
